Accepted by the owner on 2026-11-06 with partial cold-plate coverage. SP3 and
TR4 share the same four-post cooler mounting, so a TR4 bracket fits the
H12D-8D. The round H115i cold plate does not cover the whole 58 x 75 mm SP3
heat spreader, and the 7702P's outer dies sit near its edges: expect higher
temperatures and less headroom than a full-coverage TR4/SP3 cooler. Watch
CPU temperatures under all-core load and revisit if it throttles.
